verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's own docs show it can start remote sessions (including via CLI), have a module that receives incoming connections, and report a client's online status through the REST API, so reaching a remote machine is a documented capability. None of the evidence explains how the connection crosses networks when away from home. missing for 10: documentation of the relay/broker path, NAT traversal, VPN or port-forward or direct-connection setup, and hands-on confirmation of off-network access.
